subject: planner: avoid join reorder when to meet NULLEQ in the EQCond (#60416)
summary: Adds a guard in join group extraction to skip join reordering when any EqualConditions contains NullEQ (nulleq), preventing wrong results from outer-join reorder interactions with null-safe join keys; adjusts/adds planner tests for issues #60322/#57583. The same guard still exists in later history on upstream/master.
